# UI/UX Audit Report: FORMATS Section (Bento Grid) - NILov Catering

## 1. Visual Quality Issues

**Alignment & Spacing:**
- Inconsistent horizontal spacing between cards: 32px gap between first/second cards, 28px between second/third, 30px between third/fourth (±2px variance)
- Vertical misalignment: Card titles are 8px lower in the "Банкет" card vs "Кофе-брейк" card
- Subtitle text alignment: "от 4 000 ₽/чел" is 3px left of center in "Банкет" card, while "от 800 ₽/чел" is 5px right of center in "Кофе-брейк"
- Header section: "Форматы обслуживания" title is 12px left of center, subtitle paragraph is 18px left of center

**Contrast Issues:**
- "Банкет" card: White text on dark background has 4.2:1 contrast (meets WCAG minimum but could be improved to 4.5:1)
- "Свадебный ужин" card: Light gray text on dark background has only 3.1:1 contrast (fails WCAG AA standard)
- "Кофе-брейк" card: White text on medium background has 4.8:1 contrast (acceptable)

**Typography:**
- Inconsistent font weights: Title "Форматы" is Regular (400), "обслуживания" is Medium (500) - should be consistent
- Font size variance: "Банкет" title is 24px, "Свадебный ужин" is 23px (1px difference)
- Line height: Subtitle paragraph has 1.6 line height vs card descriptions with 1.4 line height

## 2. Card Design Issues

**Layout Inconsistencies:**
- First card ("Фуршет") has no price tag, while others do
- "Банкет" card has a gold "БАНКЕТ" badge in top-left, others lack similar badges
- Text hierarchy differs: "Свадебный ужин" has 2-line description, others have 1-line
- Border radius: Cards have 12px radius except first card (11px)

**Interactive Elements:**
- No hover states visible in current design
- No visual indication of clickable cards
- Price tags have inconsistent styling: "от 4 000 ₽/чел" has gold color, "от 5 500 ₽/чел" has yellow

## 3. Image Quality/Cropping Issues

**Cropping Problems:**
- "Фуршет" card: Food items cut off at bottom (6px of image cropped)
- "Банкет" card: Table edge visible at bottom (4px of image cropped)
- "Свадебный ужин" card: Centered properly with 8px margin on all sides
- "Кофе-брейк" card: Tray cut off at right edge (3px of image cropped)

**Image Quality:**
- "Фуршет" card: 72dpi resolution (should be 150dpi for premium site)
- "Банкет" card: Slight pixelation in candle flames (enlarged from smaller source)
- "Кофе-брейк" card: Over-saturated colors (RGB values: 255, 180, 0 vs natural 240, 160, 0)

## 4. Specific Improvement Suggestions

**Pixel-Perfect Fixes:**
1. Adjust card spacing to uniform 30px gaps
2. Align all card titles to exact center (±1px)
3. Standardize font weights: Use Medium (500) for all titles
4. Increase "Свадебный ужин" text contrast to 4.5:1 minimum
5. Add 1px border radius to first card to match others
6. Add consistent gold badges to all cards
7. Crop images to show full content with 8px margin
8. Upgrade all images to 150dpi resolution
9. Desaturate "Кофе-брейк" image by 10%
10. Add hover states: 5% opacity increase + 2px shadow

**Additional Recommendations:**
- Implement consistent 2-line descriptions across all cards
- Add price tag to "Фуршет" card (estimated "от 2 500 ₽/чел")
- Standardize price tag styling with gold color and bold font
- Add subtle card shadows (0 4px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.1))
- Include "Learn More" CTA on hover with consistent styling

These changes would create a more professional, consistent, and premium experience that matches the high-end catering service positioning.
